segments.t: When he finished praying in a certain place,
segments.note: Καὶ ἐγένετο は英語に現れない

segments.t: one of his disciples said to him,
“Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
He said to them, “When you pray, say,
‘Our
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Our」（ἡμῶν）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: Father
in heaven,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「in heaven」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: may your name be kept holy.
May your Kingdom come.
May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: Give us day by day our daily bread.
Forgive us our sins,
for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us.
Bring us not into temptation,
but deliver us from the evil one.’”
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「but deliver us from the evil one」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: He said to them,
“Which of you,
if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him,
segments.note: ἕξει（友を持つ）は英語に直接現れず、「go to a friend」の形にほぐされている

segments.t: ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
segments.note: 「of bread」は ἄρτους の内容を補ったもの

segments.t: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey,
and I have nothing to set before him,’
and he from within will answer and say,
‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
segments.note: 「it」は δοῦναί に含まれる目的語を表に出したもの

segments.t: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend,
segments.note: 「it」は δώσει に含まれる目的語を表に出したもの

segments.t: yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
“I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you.
Keep seeking, and you will find.
Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
“Which of you fathers, if your son asks for
bread, will give him a stone?
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「bread, will give him a stone」を補う（マタイ 7:9 の並行句）。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
segments.note: ἰχθύν は後半の節で訳出されている

segments.t: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
segments.note: 「your heavenly Father」は ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ の表現

segments.t: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute.
When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
But some of them said,
“He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them,
“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
segments.note: οἶκος ἐπὶ οἶκον（家が家に敵対して）を「A house divided against itself falls」とほぐした表現

segments.t: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
“When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
“He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
It came to pass, as he said these things,
segments.note: Ἐγένετο δὲ は英語に現れない

segments.t: a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say,
segments.note: 「to him」は英語の補い

segments.t: “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah
the prophet.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「the prophet」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them,
for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon;
and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
segments.note: 「one」は πλεῖον（より大きい者）の内容を表に出したもの

segments.t: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it,
for they repented at the preaching of Jonah;
and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
segments.note: 「one」は πλεῖον の内容を表に出したもの

segments.t: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
The lamp of the body is the eye.
Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light;
segments.note: 「Therefore」は英語の補い

segments.t: but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him.
He went in and sat at the table.
segments.note: 「at the table」は ἀνέπεσεν の内容を補ったもの

segments.t: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within,
segments.note: 「to the needy」は ἐλεημοσύνην の受け手を補ったもの

segments.t: and behold, all things will be clean to you.
But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love.
You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
Woe to you,
scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites!
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
He said,
“Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry,
and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
segments.note: προσψαύετε τοῖς φορτίοις（一指も重荷に触れない）を「lift one finger to help carry」とほぐした表現

segments.t: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
segments.note: 「their」は μνημεῖα を受ける。対応する独立の語はない

segments.t: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’
Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
As he said these things to them,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文の読み（λέγοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα πρὸς αὐτούς）に従う。ギリシャ語本文の Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ に対応する英語はない

segments.t: the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say,
that they might accuse him.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「that they might accuse him」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない
